workflow-saas.description: A multi-tenant SaaS platform for business operations, combining lightweight CRM, task management and configurable approval workflows.
workflow-saas.overview: WorkFlow SaaS is a business management platform designed to help small companies centralize customer relationships, team collaboration, task assignments and approval processes through an integrated web application.
workflow-saas.problem: Small businesses often manage customers, employees, tasks and approval processes across disconnected tools. This creates operational fragmentation, limited traceability, inconsistent workflows and security challenges when multiple organizations share the same platform.
workflow-saas.solution: A modular monolith SaaS application that centralizes business operations through a REST API and an integrated web interface. The platform is designed around organization-level data isolation, granular permissions, versioned approval workflows and asynchronous processing.
features: Multi-tenant architecture with organization-level data isolation.
User authentication and secure session management.
Role-based access control (RBAC) and granular permissions.
CRM module for customers, contacts and sales opportunities.
Task management with priorities, assignments and deadlines.
Approval management with sequential decision processes.
Automated testing and CI/CD pipeline strategy.
Docker-based development and AWS deployment strategy.
workflow-saas.architecture: React + TypeScript frontend → HTTPS / REST → FastAPI API v1 → Authentication → Authorization / Tenant Context → Application Services → SQLAlchemy → PostgreSQL. Celery workers use Redis for asynchronous jobs, notifications, exports and scheduled tasks.
highlights: Asynchronous processing with Celery and Redis.
CI/CD and cloud deployment strategy with AWS.

medlab.description: A LIMS-inspired platform for biomedical laboratories, covering samples, tests, equipment, reporting and operational workflows.
medlab.overview: MedLab Platform is a biomedical laboratory management system designed to organize laboratory operations, manage samples and tests, monitor biomedical equipment and generate technical reports.
medlab.problem: Biomedical laboratories require reliable workflows for tracking samples, laboratory tests, equipment and results. Managing these processes independently can make traceability and operational control difficult.
medlab.solution: A modular backend platform that centralizes laboratory entities and operational workflows through a REST API.
medlab.architecture: Router → Service → Repository → SQLAlchemy → PostgreSQL. Background operations are processed through Celery workers and Redis-compatible infrastructure.

instrumenthub.description: A platform for acquisition, processing, storage and real-time visualization of biomedical instrument and sensor data.
instrumenthub.overview: InstrumentHub connects instrument communication, data acquisition, signal processing and real-time monitoring in a modular engineering platform.
instrumenthub.problem: Biomedical instrumentation requires reliable acquisition pipelines, signal analysis, data persistence and visualization of measurements.
instrumenthub.solution: A platform integrating acquisition services, processing modules, time-series storage and a web dashboard.
instrumenthub.architecture: Instrument → Acquisition Manager → Measurement and Signal Processing → Time-Series Storage → REST API / WebSocket → React Dashboard.

digital-thermometer.description: An embedded temperature acquisition and display system built around a microcontroller and peripheral interfaces.
digital-thermometer.overview: An embedded engineering project focused on acquiring temperature measurements and displaying the resulting values.
digital-thermometer.problem: Temperature monitoring requires the integration of sensor acquisition, microcontroller processing and user-readable output.
digital-thermometer.solution: An embedded implementation using a PIC microcontroller and peripheral communication interfaces.
digital-thermometer.architecture: Sensor → ADC → PIC18F4550 → Processing → Display Interface.

fbg-research.description: Research on UV-induced fiber Bragg gratings, experimental characterization and temperature–strain decoupling.
fbg-research.overview: Research focused on optical fiber sensors based on fiber Bragg gratings and their characterization for measurement applications.
fbg-research.problem: Temperature and mechanical strain can influence the wavelength response of FBG sensors, requiring appropriate characterization and decoupling methodologies.
fbg-research.solution: An experimental and analytical research approach involving optical sensing, characterization and signal analysis.
fbg-research.architecture: Optical Sensor → Measurement Instrumentation → Data Acquisition → Signal Processing → Experimental Analysis.
